-- VENDOR.CSV
SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'calendar.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        FIELDTERMINATOR = ',',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result]

-----SET DATA TYPE ------- 

EXEC sp_describe_first_result_set N'SELECT
    TOP 100 *
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK ''calendar.csv'',
        DATA_SOURCE = ''nyc_taxi_data_raw'',
        FORMAT = ''CSV'',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        FIELDTERMINATOR = '','',
        PARSER_VERSION = ''2.0''
    ) AS [result]'

------- IDENTIFY MAX LENTH AND SET DATA TAYPES -----
SELECT
    MAX(LEN(date_key)) AS date_key,
    MAX(LEN(date)) AS date,
    MAX(LEN(year)) AS year,
    MAX(LEN(month)) AS month,
    MAX(LEN(day)) AS day,
    MAX(LEN(day_name)) AS day_name,
    MAX(LEN(day_of_year)) AS day_of_year,
    MAX(LEN(week_of_month)) AS week_of_month,
    MAX(LEN(week_of_year)) AS week_of_year,
    MAX(LEN(month_name)) AS month_name ,
      MAX(LEN(year_month)) AS year_month ,
        MAX(LEN(year_week)) AS year_week 
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://adlscoursesynapse.dfs.core.windows.net/nyc-taxi-green-data/raw/calendar.csv',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        FIELDTERMINATOR = ',',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    ) AS [result]

------ SET DATA TYPE ------

SELECT*
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'calendar.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_taxi_data_raw'
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        FIELDTERMINATOR = ',',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
    )
   WITH (
    date_key       INT,
    date           DATE,
    year           SMALLINT,
    month          TINYINT,
    day            TINYINT,
    day_name       VARCHAR(10),
    day_of_year    SMALLINT,
    week_of_month  TINYINT,
    week_of_year   TINYINT,
    month_name     VARCHAR(10),
    year_week      INT
)AS [calendar_result]
